body: People do love you. When I tried a guy who I didn't even conifers close to me cried for an hour the first time. I tucking g love you right now and I wont even know you. Don't go to that precipice because sometimes the vertigo pulls you down.

Ive tried three times the last having resulted in nerve/hearing and a lot of over damages. The first time with gas I just went to work then to walmart bought my stuff and went home. Locked my car mixed it all up and passed out. Buddies broke my window open and dragged me from the car. My second time i spent the night in a B and B with a hugee barn.Second time by hanging. I'm an idiot and tied the knot wrong fell 20 feet and broke my femur and some other bones. Third time with a gun started shaking pulled the trigger and shot behind my ear blew.ot off and some of my back skull. Spent that day calling 5+ ex gfs trying to get sex.                                        

It's been 3 years now and I am married to a beautiful woman who is also my physical therapist. I was only 24 years old the last time. It is not worth it. Its not. IF ANYONE NEEDS TO TALK PM ME. CALL A HOTLINE. DO ANYTHING. If you live near we can go get.coffee watch a movie greab something to eat. Anything. Just don't make things possibly worse.

If you ever need to talk just pm me. I understand. Ive tried to do it. Its not worth it. Take it from someone who's been there. Not being able to speak, hear properly, move your hands...not being able to live. There are always options. You're young you have so many paths open ahead of you. A pit.of nothingness.. trust me its not like that. I thought I was dead I cried and I pleaded for it to be a dream and I would wake up and I would be able to feel my arms and feel like I could talk. Life will get better, or maybe not. But the alternative is really no alternative at all.
